title: Employees
description: Manage employees, project assignments, and time entries.

timesheets.title: Timesheets
timesheets.description: Employee period timesheets — draft, submit, approve or return, then lock. Not payroll.
timesheets.detailDescription: Period hours and workflow for one employee week.
timesheets.notPayroll: Timesheets track hours for operations and labor Actual. This is not payroll.
timesheets.lockedHint: Period is locked. Silent edits are blocked — use void + insert correction for changes.

empty.title: No timesheets yet
empty.description: Submit time entries to create a period timesheet for the employee week.

employees.newDescription: Name and role first. Add compensation under Advanced when you know cost - rates alone do not create project labor Actual.

empty.title: No employees yet
empty.description: Path: Employees → New employee. After creating people, assign them here or on a project (Team → Add employee), or log time.

form.name: Name
form.employmentStyleHint: Hourly, daily, or monthly - only needed if you enter a rate.
form.baseRateHint: Optional. Labor Actual on a project only appears after time is logged. You can save with no salary.
form.burdenHint: Loaded cost on top of the base rate, e.g. taxes and benefits. Not net salary / payroll.
form.jobTitleHint: What they do - e.g. site manager, electrician, admin.
form.linkedUserHint: Connect this employee to an organization member so they can log their own time and clock in. Unlink anytime.
form.standardHoursPerDayHint: Hours above this count as excess and need manager approval. Empty = organization default.
form.advancedHint: Compensation and contact details. Skip forever if you only need names for time logging.
form.assignmentHintMuted: Assign later from this employee or Project → Team. Assignment ≠ labor Actual.

detail.title: Employee
detail.dailyCapacityHint: Hours above this framework are marked as excess and require approval.
detail.dailyCapacityMissing: No daily framework configured. Set it under Settings, Catalog, or on the employee.
detail.addRateHint: Creates a new rate version from the chosen date. Past versions stay unchanged.
detail.addRateSuccess: Rate version saved. History was not rewritten.
detail.complianceEmpty: No compliance artifacts for this employee yet.
detail.archiveConfirm: Archive this employee? History and time entries are kept. There is no hard delete.

projects.title: Assignments / projects
projects.description: Projects this person is assigned to. Assignment itself is not a cost - labor Actual comes from time entries.
projects.assignSuccess: Assigned. No labor Actual was created.
projects.empty: Not assigned to any project yet. Use Add assignment, or open a project → Team → Add employee.
projects.noProjects: No available projects, or this person is already on every active project.
projects.hoursSummary: {hours} h · {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}

time.title: Time entries
time.description: Hours logged against projects and non-project codes.
time.selfDescription: Your hours. Clocking is presence only - these entries are what count for project cost after approval.
time.quickLogDescription: Log hours in a few taps - employee, date, hours, project, and notes.
time.quickLogProjectDescription: Log hours on this project. Team members appear first; you can still pick any org employee. Hours create labor Actual when a rate applies - team assignment alone does not.
time.correctionDescription: Voids the original entry and saves a replacement. Past Actual is not silently overwritten.

excess.pending: Excess {hours} h — waiting for manager approval

approvals.title: Timesheet approvals
approvals.description: Approve submitted hours before they become labor Actual. Draft, waiting, and returned rows do not cost.
approvals.queueHint: Only submitted rows can be approved. Returning requires a manager note.
approvals.managerNoteRequired: A note is required when returning a timesheet.
approvals.successApproved: Approved. These hours now count as labor Actual.

empty.title: No timesheets waiting
empty.description: Submitted hours appear here for review. Nothing is required until someone submits a timesheet.

empty.title: No time logged yet
empty.description: Log hours when work happens to build project labor cost from real time, not guesses.

form.weekdaysHint: Only selected days in the range are saved.
form.bulkPreviewSummary: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · {hours} hours total
form.correctionNotice: Saving will void the original entry and insert this replacement.
form.noEmployees: Add an employee first (Employees → New employee), then come back to log time.
form.dailyExcessTitle: This entry exceeds the employee's daily hours framework
form.dailyExcessConfirm: I understand — save including excess hours

projectPanel.title: Time on this project
projectPanel.summary: {hours} hours across {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
projectPanel.teamDescription: Current assignments with dates. Adding someone does not create labor cost - Actual only comes from logged time.
projectPanel.teamEmpty: No one assigned yet. Use Add employee to put someone on this team.
projectPanel.addSuccess: Employee added to the team. No labor Actual was created.
projectPanel.endAssignmentDescription: End {name}'s assignment on this project. Historical time entries stay; this does not change Actual cost.
projectPanel.editAssignmentSuccess: Assignment updated. No labor Actual was changed.
projectPanel.cancelAssignmentDescription: Mark {name}'s assignment as cancelled. Time entries stay; this does not change Actual cost.
projectPanel.startDateHint: Defaults to today. Leave as-is for the simple path.
projectPanel.plannedShareHint: Planning hint only - not cost allocation and not Actual.
projectPanel.noCandidates: Every active employee is already on this team, or create a new employee first.
projectPanel.memberHours: {hours} h · {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}

monthReview.title: Monthly employer cost (optional)
monthReview.description: Review estimated vs actual employer cost for a month. Not on daily field nav.
monthReview.gateOff: Persistence is off until Lead enables monthly cost after migration. Preview and draft only - does not claim Actual.
monthReview.actualHint: Known employer cost for the month - not net salary / payroll.
monthReview.methodHint: How to weight projects when splitting known cost. Advanced only.
monthReview.allocatedInputHint: Sum already allocated. Remainder stays visible as unallocated.
monthReview.draftSaved: Draft saved. Actual is unchanged until allocation is applied.
monthReview.applied: Month allocation applied. Project labor Actual now uses monthly lines (displacement).
monthReview.disclaimer: Monthly cost recognition is separate from assignment and from time snapshots until applied.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Clock in and out for presence. Attendance is not project time and never creates labor Actual by itself.
attendance.disclaimer: Presence only - not project hours and not cost.
attendance.completenessHint: Complete is a presence heuristic: at least one clock-in and currently clocked out. It is not a timesheet or payroll completeness check and does not create labor cost. Open means still on site, or the day has no closing clock-out yet.

clock.presenceVsTime: Clocking records presence. Hours that count for cost are logged under Time.
clock.linkRequired: Link your user to an employee record to use the clock.

dayStatus.open: Open (still on site or no clock-out)

list.title: Attendance days
list.hint: Filter by date or status. Open a day for events and corrections. Status is presence only - see the completeness note.

empty.title: No attendance yet
empty.description: Optional - use the clock or a manager manual entry when you need presence tracking. Nothing is required to set up.

manual.title: Manual entry
manual.description: Managers can record presence retrospectively. Still not project time or cost.
manual.noEmployees: Add an employee first, then return to enter attendance.

errors.invalidWorkPackage: The work area does not belong to this project.
errors.invalidPhase: The phase does not belong to this project.
errors.duplicateTeamMember: This employee is already on the project team.
errors.invalidBulkRange: The bulk date range or weekday filter is invalid.
errors.emptyBulk: No days matched the selected range and weekdays.
errors.timeEntryAlreadyVoid: This time entry is already void.
errors.timeEntryArchived: Cannot correct an archived time entry.
errors.closedMonthNeedsProject: Cannot post a closed-month economic correction without a project. Date a reversing time entry in an open month, or assign the original entry to a project.
errors.closedMonthCurrencyMismatch: Closed-month time correction requires the same cost currency on the original and replacement.
errors.invalidTimesheetTransition: This timesheet status change is not allowed.
errors.timesheetPeriodApproved: This week is already approved. Use a time correction for approved hours.
errors.timesheetPeriodLocked: This timesheet period is locked. Use a time correction instead of editing silently.
errors.timesheetEmployeeMismatch: Time entries must belong to the same employee.
errors.nothingToSubmit: There are no draft or returned hours to submit.
errors.managerNoteRequired: A manager note is required when returning a timesheet.
errors.timeEntryApprovedLocked: Approved hours are locked. Use Correct to change them.
errors.timeEntryNotEditable: Only draft or returned hours can be edited. Submitted hours wait for approval.
errors.noLinkedEmployee: Your login is not linked to an employee record.
errors.attendanceSelfScope: You can only view or clock your own attendance.
errors.attendanceEventVoided: This attendance event is already void.
errors.timeSelfScope: You can only view or log time for the employee linked to your login.
errors.selfApprovalBlocked: You cannot approve your own timesheet. Ask another manager or the owner.
errors.userNotInOrganization: That login is not an active member of this organization.
errors.userAlreadyLinked: That login is already linked to another employee.
errors.dailyHoursExceeded: Reported hours exceed the employee's daily framework.
errors.timeEntryNotDeletable: Only draft or returned entries can be deleted.
errors.noExcessHours: This entry has no excess hours.
errors.excessExceedsEntryHours: Excess hours cannot exceed entry hours.
errors.excessStatusRequired: Excess hours require an approval status.
errors.breakStartInvalid: Start a break only while clocked in.
errors.breakEndInvalid: You are not on a break.
